messages:
jess_sales: Heads-up — Ethos POC. They tried to spin up the dedicated GPU pool in ap-south1 and the pool never becomes Ready. Customer is blocked for tomorrow's demo. Can eng-runtime take a look?

matt_cs: They reported these errors in the UI logs: 
```\nERROR: pool-init: node-attach failed: AttachDeviceError: failed to attach GPU device: ENODEV\nCaused by: quotaExceeded for nvidia-tesla-t4 in ap-south1
```
Also see some image pull failures intermittently.

sanjay_eng_runtime: Thanks. Two quick asks: 1) do they need a specific instance family (T4/RTX A5000) pinned? 2) did they request AZ affinity or strict reservation?

jess_sales: They asked for "best-effort dedicated T4s" and wanted AZ-aware placement to keep latency low. Not strict reservation.

olivia_eng_platform: If it's best-effort + AZ-aware we should not hit reservation code-paths. QuotaExceeded suggests cloud-side quota or regional availability. Can we get the cluster create payload and the pool config?

jess_sales: Dropping the pool json and the terraform snippet: 
```\nresource "redwood_gpu_pool" "ethos_poc" {\n  region = "ap-south1"\n  gpu_type = "t4"\n  min_size = 2\n  max_size = 8\n  azs = ["ap-south1-a", "ap-south1-b"]\n  reservation = "best-effort"\n  image = "registry.redwood-inference/private-runtime:v2.1"\n}\n```

kevin_support: Image pull failures -> looks like private registry auth. Do they have an RBAC token mounted for that env? If image pulls fail, nodes will repeatedly try and then pool provisioning times out.

matt_cs: They said they used the standard onboarding creds from the onboarding doc. Not sure if that includes the private-runtime image.

sanjay_eng_runtime: Two simultaneous issues likely: cloud GPU quota + private image auth. Steps: 1) confirm cloud GPU quota availability for T4 in ap-south1 2) check registry pull secret on node bootstrap 3) look at pool controller logs for the ENODEV path (kernel/device vs driver mismatch).

infra-bot: [quota-check] ap-south1: t4 GPUs available=0, gpus_reserved=10, limit=10

olivia_eng_platform: infra-bot confirms: quota exhausted in region. That's why AttachDeviceError/ENODEV surfaced. For demos we can offer two options: a) failover to ap-south1 -> ap-south2? (not available) b) run demo in a different region with capacity (e.g., us-west2) and enable cross-region routing in the demo.

jess_sales: Customer insisted ap-south1 due to data residency. Can we request temporary quota bump or offer Dedicated reserved capacity via an expedited SA?

kevin_support: We can open a quota increase request with the cloud account, but quota bumps sometimes take hours-days. For Dedicated sales POCs we can offer a short-term reserved pool on our shared fleet labeled "POC burst" if legal/security approves. Needs sales+ops signoff.

matt_cs: They also asked pricing: If we do "POC burst" on shared fleet, what's the rate? Need an hourly estimate to confirm with procurement.

olivia_eng_platform: Pricing — use "shared-burst" SKU which is 3x hosted per-token baseline + GPU-hour surcharge. I'll DM finance for exact number and add to this thread.

sanjay_eng_runtime: Meanwhile I dug into the node logs for one failed node: 
```\nNov 04 08:12:31 kubelet: device-plugin: failed to list devices: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection refused\nNov 04 08:12:33 kernel: nvidia 0000:01:00.0: BAR0 region mismatch\n```
That suggests driver mismatch on image or stale kernel module on node image. If we're using our private-runtime image, ensure it includes the compatible nvidia-driver version or use our runtime base that has driver preloaded.

jess_sales: Okay. Action items?

kevin_support: I'll open a ticket with cloud quotas and request expedited bump (include account id).

olivia_eng_platform: I'll confirm pricing for shared-burst and legal signoff path.

sanjay_eng_runtime: I'll prepare a fallback plan: 1) if quota bump not possible same-day, propose us-west2 demo and set up cross-region routing; 2) patch the node bootstrap to include registry pull secret and driver version alignment; provide a one-click patch command.

matt_cs: I'll coordinate with Ethos to get account id and permission to escalate quotas. Also confirm whether they can accept demo in us-west2 as fallback.

jess_sales: Thanks team — please post updates here. Ethos needs a go/no-go by EOD. :pray:
